name: cloudpeek-plugins
description: Official CloudPeek plugins: incident triage and investigation in your own tenant, and anonymous CVE and CWE lookup from a public indexed corpus.

plugins.name: cloudpeek
plugins.description: Connect your agent to CloudPeek, the AI security teammate. Triage the 5% of alerts that matter, run investigations, and manage incidents through the hosted CloudPeek MCP gateway.

plugins.name: cloudpeek-vulnerability-intelligence
plugins.description: Look up CVEs and CWEs from CloudPeek's indexed Open Knowledge Format corpus. Deterministic, source-grounded vulnerability intelligence with no embeddings and no model calls.
